title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 XXE via Maven settings file upload was possible (CVE-2026-132240)
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 allows XML External Entity (XXE) attacks via the upload of a Maven settings file. This flaw could enable an attacker with limited privileges to cause a high-impact confidentiality breach without user interaction.
